map.跟节拍练习时记录各次点击间隔看稳不稳: Record each tap interval while practising to the beat to see how steady you are
map.给无标签音频粗测速度，方便归类或混音: Coarse speed measurement for untagged audio, handy for sorting or mixing

map.至少 4–8 拍取平均更稳；前 1–2 拍易因起手不准舍去，用中间稳定段算平均间: Averaging at least 4–8 beats is more stable; the first 1–2 beats are often discarded for an imprecise start, so average the stable middle segment.
